name: preallow
description: Lets Claude Code auto mode run the steps of the task you gave without the classifier: a model judge allows what is reversible or what you explicitly asked for

model.title: Judge model
model.description: The model the judge of every call runs on, passed to the model client as you write it: an alias or a full model id. Leave empty for the plugin's default pair, haiku with a second judge on opus. If you set it and leave Escalation model empty, there is no second judge.

effort.title: Judge effort
effort.description: How hard the judge of every call thinks, passed to the model client as you write it. Leave empty for the plugin's default.

escalation_model.title: Escalation model
escalation_model.description: The model of a second judge for every call the first judge did not allow, failures included; it judges the call again from the start, and its verdict is final. Passed as you write it. Leave empty for opus when Judge model is empty too, or for no second judge when you set Judge model.

escalation_effort.title: Escalation effort
escalation_effort.description: How hard the second judge thinks, passed to the model client as you write it. Leave empty for the plugin's default. Setting it does not add a second judge on its own.
